en: The postcard is split into two black-and-white photographic sections. The upper image depicts a traditional Scandinavian wooden house with a tiled roof, cozy front porch, and a flagpole in front, surrounded by trees and a simple garden. The lower image shows a white-painted stone church with a square tower and tall windows. Tree branches frame the view, and there are gravestones visible, indicating a churchyard. Below the images is Swedish text, some of it handwritten.
